[2:06PM] #IkoroduRoad #Mile12 #TrafficUpdate 

Vehicular movement from Odo Ogun down to Owode Onirin and onward to Mile 12 is experiencing better flow. Similarly, under the Mile 12 bridge, both inward and outward movements towards Ajelogo are currently good. Motorists will find traffic at the ascent and descent of the Mile 12 bridge inward Kosofe down to Iyana School to be fast paced. 

Furthermore, movement from under the Mile 12 bridge inward the main market is good. The return journey from Iyana School down to Mile 12 is smooth, and ascending and descending the Mile 12 bridge inward Owode Onirin to Irawo down to Odo Ogun is without obstruction. 

 There are currently no recorded impediments in these areas, and our traffic structures are actively on ground, monitoring and ensuring free flow.

[2:26PM] #Ejigbo #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is currently moving at a steady pace from Pako Oke Afa to Jakande.
Motorists can expect better movement from the NNPC intersection at Iyana Ejigbo, through Powerline, Egbe, Cele, Ile Iwe, and the Synagogue area, continuing to the Oju Odo Ikotun intersection en route to Old Garage.

However, both the Ijegun Road and the stretch from Jakande Gate toward Pako are experiencing slow movement.
From the Ikotun intersection down to the NNPC junction, traffic is flowing well, connecting smoothly to Mobolaji Johnson Road (Mobostic) inward Canoe. There is steady movement from Canoe back to Mobostic.

Our traffic managers are actively present ensuring smooth flow, and there are no reported impediments in these areas at present.
